authenticity_review: The image demonstrates high technical quality with sharp focus and natural lighting. However, a notable texture anomaly exists: the surface gloss is excessively uniform and specular, resembling plastic or resin more than organic baked pastry. Real glazes typically show micro-variations in thickness and reflection; here, the highlights are too perfect and consistent across all layers. This suggests an AI texturing artifact where the material properties were rendered with synthetic smoothness. Structural integrity and lamination details remain convincing, preventing a lower authenticity score, but the surface finish prevents a perfect rating.
key_defects: Texture anomaly: Excessive, uniform glossiness on croissant surfaces resembling plastic/resin rather than organic baked glaze.
